name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.objective_certificate
statement:
theorem objective_certificate (m a z b : ℝ) (t : ℕ)
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haz : a ≤ z) (hzb : z ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1) :
    a * (1 - b) ^ t + (1 - b) * (1 - (1 - a) / m) ^ t ≤
        branchObjective m t z ∧
      branchObjective m t z ≤
        b * (1 - a) ^ t + (1 - a) * (1 - (1 - b) / m) ^ t

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.objective_certificate_nat

    a * (1 - b) ^ t + (1 - b) * (1 - (1 - a) / (m : ℝ)) ^ t ≤
        branchObjective (m : ℝ) t z ∧
      branchObjective (m : ℝ) t z ≤
        b * (1 - a) ^ t + (1 - a) * (1 - (1 - b) / (m : ℝ)) ^ t
